body:
version: '1'
kind: miner
id: 710637
slug: zk-sanctions
protocol: generic
name: Sanctions Name Evidence
description: Keyless name screening from official OFAC SDN and non-SDN snapshots with
  published dates, plus UK entity designations. Returns listed names, aliases, program
  tags and explainable similarity scores. A name match needs identity review and a
  negative is not sanctions clearance.
base_url: https://telegraph-s2-sanctions.margyn.workers.dev
auth:
  type: none
docs:
  documentation: https://telegraph-s2-sanctions.margyn.workers.dev/health
rate_limit_per_sec: 2
cache_ttl_sec: 10
circuit_threshold: 5
circuit_cooldown_seconds: 30
limitations:
- code: MAX_PARAM_SIZE
  message: Name must be at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.
  param: name
  property: size_bytes
  value_bytes: 256
  operator: lte
errors:
  message_path: error.message
  code_path: error.code
  status_path: status
  success_values:
  - ok
input_schema:
  type: object
  properties:
    name:
      type: string
      minLength: 1
      maxLength: 256
      description: Person or entity name, not a question or wallet address.
output_schema:
  type: object
  properties:
    name:
      type: string
    matched:
      type:
      - boolean
      - 'null'
    matches:
      type: array
      items:
        type: object
    lists:
      type: array
      items:
        type: string
    match_score:
      type:
      - number
      - 'null'
      minimum: 0
      maximum: 1
    summary:
      type: string
    confidence:
      type: number
      minimum: 0
      maximum: 1
    source:
      type: array
      items:
        type: object
    as_of:
      type:
      - string
      - 'null'
    status:
      type: string
      enum:
      - ok
      - unavailable
endpoints:
- path: /screen
  external_path: /screen
  method: GET
  intents:
  - SANCTIONS_SCREENING_MATCH_GENERAL
  description: Screen exactly one person or entity name using ?name=. Matches official
    primary names and aliases, reordered names and close spelling. The matched boolean
    is a name alert, not confirmed identity. Lists are dated snapshots; UK coverage
    is entities only. Do not pass a full question, DOB, wallet address or country
    in name.
  params:
    query:
      required:
      - name: name
        type: string
        intents:
        - SANCTIONS_SCREENING_MATCH_GENERAL
        description: Person or entity name, 1 to 256 UTF-8 bytes.
intent_mapping:
  SANCTIONS_SCREENING_MATCH_GENERAL:
    endpoint: /screen
    input:
      name:
        from: name
        how: Copy the person or entity name verbatim.
    output:
      name:
        path: name
      matched:
        path: matched
      matches:
        path: matches
      lists:
        path: lists
      match_score:
        path: match_score
        unit: fraction (0-1)
semantics:
  signal_mapping:
    label_field: summary
    reason_field: summary
    confidence_field: confidence
  supported_intents:
  - SANCTIONS_SCREENING_MATCH_GENERAL
